Name: Jerry the Flamingo (CP and AT)
Author: pumpkinpatchin
Description:
[b]An Offering:
[/b]
This mod replaces the standard pink lawn flamingo with a black and pink variation inspired by Jerry, the feathered mascot from Sleep Token's [i]Even in Arcadia[/i] album.

[b]Select:[/b]

Two formats are provided. They function as such:
[list]
[*]The Content Patcher version replaces the existing lawn flamingo with Jerry[/*]
[*]The Alternative Textures version requires you to obtain the bucket tool from Robin's shop, and apply the texture to the pink lawn flamingo. You may search for "Jerry" in the Alternatives Texture search field, and he will appear: somber and eternal and prepared to be painted onto a pre-existing surface.[/*]
[/list][b]Install:[/b]

Open the zip file, and add either the [b][CP] Jerry the Flamingo[/b] folder or the [b][AT] Jerry the Flamingo[/b] to your mods folder. They may coexist peaceably together, should you install them at the same time. Please review the requirements for each file, as they have differing pre-requisites to function.

[b]Obtain:[/b]

The Lawn Flamingo can be obtained from Pierre's booth for 400g at the Egg Festival, or by looking up "lawn flamingo" in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB's Item Spawner[/url].

[b]Disclaimed:

[/b]Jerry the Flamingo is a fan-made project; not an official artwork. It is a small act of gratitude and a token of affection for the original flamingo that inspired it. I am not seeking compensation for this act of devotion, monetary or otherwise.
